headline: The Rise of Bread Festivals: Agoda Unveils Top "Bread Pilgrimage" Destinations in South Korea
summary: Driven by South Korea's vibrant cafe culture and the growing popularity of bakery-themed events, "bread pilgrimages" have emerged as one of the latest travel trends. Today, South Koreans are willing to travel in search of the perfect loaf, visiting renowned bakeries and bread festivals across the country. The phenomenon gained even greater momentum after actor Beomjun Seo embarked on a bread pilgrimage in the entertainment show "I Live Alone," inspiring viewers to explore famous bakeries. Reflec
